A high school freshman and a retiree were talking together about risk-taking, specifically focusing on risky behavior like starting fights. The high school freshman never gets into confrontations and avoids them at all costs, while the retiree ends up in fights pretty often, and is usually the one who started it. Who is a risk-taker?
A. The retiree
B. The high school freshman
C. Not answerable
